MI5 Chief Warns Iran Expanding UK Target Scope to Military Sites

Britain's domestic security service, MI5, has warned that Iran is expanding its targeting of UK military sites, a shift described as "not unique" by MI5 Chief Ken McCallum. McCallum stated in an annual speech that Tehran's "ambitions" have seen a "major shift" towards attacking military installations and other high-security locations. This comes as Iran reportedly fortifies its nuclear sites, preparing for potential U.S. strikes following midterms.
